name: ui-clone-skills
description: Clone any live website into React + Tailwind code with extraction-first verification — no vision tokens. Three skills: ui-reverse-engineering (URL → React + Tailwind, supports GSAP / Framer Motion / Lenis / Webflow IX2 / Next.js / Tailwind v4), ui-capture (reference + transitions), visual-debug (AE/SSIM diff + computed-style mismatch diagnosis).

interface.shortDescription: Clone live website URLs to React + Tailwind — verified, no vision tokens.
interface.longDescription: Clones any live website into React + Tailwind code with extraction-first verification — no vision tokens, real CSS/JS bundle analysis instead of screenshots. Exposes the same three public skills as the Claude Code plugin from shared ./skills/: ui-reverse-engineering routes live URLs to React + Tailwind builds (supports GSAP, Framer Motion, Lenis, Webflow IX2, Next.js, Tailwind v4); ui-capture records reference screenshots, scroll evidence, and transitions; visual-debug diagnoses implementation mismatches via AE/SSIM diff and computed-style evidence. Includes lifecycle hooks through hooks/codex-hooks.json -> hooks/shim.sh when Codex plugin hooks are enabled, and uses AGENTS.md as the canonical project guide.
defaultPrompt: Use ui-reverse-engineering for live URL builds, uncertain routing, partial or failed runs, and completed-state handoff into React + Tailwind.
Use ui-capture only to capture fresh reference screenshots, scroll evidence, transitions, or implementation clips.
Use visual-debug only when reference and implementation evidence already exist and the task is AE/SSIM mismatch diagnosis.

For continuation, run python -m ui_clone.goal <ref-dir> and follow the goal card as one bounded delegated-worker action; stop when current_gate == "done" and section comparison is clean. This is not an infinite loop.
